policy-options {
   community community-1 members [1:100];
   policy-statement prefix-list-150 {
      term prefixes {
         from {
            route-filter 10.1.0.0/16 exact accept;
            route-filter 10.10.0.0/15 prefix-length-range /16-/16 accept;
            route-filter 10.10.1.0/24 exact accept;
            route-filter 10.12.0.0/16 exact accept;
         }
      }
      term catch-rest {
          then reject;
      }
   }

  policy-statement policy_2_1 {
      term policy_2_1-term-1 {
         from {
 policy prefix-list-150;
         }
         then {
            local-preference 990;
            metric 5;
            community add community-1;
            accept;
         }
      }
   }


   policy-statement prefix-list-151 {
      term prefixes {
         from {
            route-filter 10.2.0.0/16 exact accept;
         }
      }
      term catch-rest {
          then reject;
      }
   }

policy-statement policy_2_1 {
      term policy_2_1-term-2 {
         from {
 policy prefix-list-151;
         }
         then {
            accept;
         }
      }
   }


   policy-statement prefix-list-152 {
      term prefixes {
         from {
            route-filter 0.0.0.0/8 upto /32 reject;
            route-filter 10.0.0.0/8 upto /32 reject;
            route-filter 127.0.0.0/8 upto /32 reject;
         }
      }
      term catch-rest {
          then accept;
      }
   }

policy-statement policy_2_1 {
      term policy_2_1-term-3 {
         from {
 policy prefix-list-152;
         }
         then {
            accept;
         }
      }
   }


   policy-statement policy_2_1 {
      term policy_2_1-catch-rest {
         then reject;
      }
   }
}

protocols {
   bgp {
      group peer-10.0.0.2 {
         type external;
         peer-as 2;
         neighbor 10.0.0.2 {
            import policy_2_1 ;
            family inet {
                unicast;
            }
         }
      }
   }
}

policy-options {
  policy-statement policy_4_3 {
      term policy_4_3-term-1 {
         from {
 policy prefix-list-152;
         }
         then {
            accept;
         }
      }
   }


   as-path as-path-50 " 4((1|10-12|14))*";

   community community-2 members [4:1];

   policy-statement community-pol-50 {
      term comm-50-1 {
          from {
            community [ community-2 ];
         }
         then accept;
      }
      term community-50-catch-rest {
         then reject;
      }
   }

policy-statement policy_4_3 {
      term policy_4_3-term-2 {
         from {
            as-path as-path-50;
 policy community-pol-50;
         }
         then {
            accept;
         }
      }
   }


   policy-statement policy_4_3 {
      term policy_4_3-catch-rest {
         then reject;
      }
   }
}

policy-options {
  policy-statement policy_5_4 {
      term policy_5_4-term-1 {
         from {
 policy prefix-list-152;
         }
         then {
            accept;
         }
      }
   }


   policy-statement prefix-list-155 {
      term prefixes {
         from {
            route-filter 10.5.0.0/16 exact accept;
         }
      }
      term catch-rest {
          then reject;
      }
   }

policy-statement policy_5_4 {
      term policy_5_4-term-2 {
         from {
 policy prefix-list-155;
         }
         then {
            as-path-prepend "1 1 ";
            accept;
         }
      }
   }


   community community-3 members [5:666];

   policy-statement community-pol-51 {
      term comm-51-1 {
         from community [ community-3 ];
         then reject;
      }
      term community-51-catch-rest {
         then accept;
      }
      term community-51-catch-rest {
         then reject;
      }
   }

policy-statement policy_5_4 {
      term policy_5_4-term-3 {
         from {
 policy community-pol-51;
         }
         then {
            as-path-prepend "1 1 ";
            accept;
         }
      }
   }


   policy-statement policy_5_4 {
      term policy_5_4-catch-rest {
         then reject;
      }
   }
}
